title: Imperial Star Destroyer — Tractor Beam Interception
description: A broad dagger hull with a recessed machinery belt, three tapering command decks, twin shield spheres and seven recessed ion engines. A removable miniature blockade runner waits beneath the illuminated ventral docking bay. Two compact black cradles support the destroyer.

sections.name: Dagger armour and curved deck shoulders
T shaped bridge and paired shield generators
Three large and four auxiliary ion engines
